reconstruction_priority: Puppet craniofacial profile craft — AI often distorts handcrafted clay planes into either smooth digital CGI or grotesque elderly caricatures
Miniature wooden clothespin mechanics — AI frequently fails to render functional miniature spring pegs, turning them into solid wooden wedges or floating artifacts
Tactile raw fabric weave and fray — AI typically smooths textile surfaces instead of capturing raw linen weave and frayed fiber edges
Macro optical depth of field — AI struggles to maintain sharp focus on both the profile face and the raised hands while smoothly blurring the background stone courtyard
